verdict.rationale: CSC is a SaaS entity-management and registered-agent platform, so official SDKs are a fair thing to ask about. The evidence only mentions secure APIs and prebuilt integrations (ELM, Workday, Docusign), with no official SDK or client library. APIs and integrations are adjacent building blocks, not SDKs, and the probes found no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.
